modules.title: Linear Stacks & Monotonic Sequences
modules.description: Parentheses matching, delimiter balancing, and nearest greater/smaller element queries.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming & State Transitions

modules.title: Traffic Shaping & Token Bucket Rate Limiting

curriculum_tracks.title: SQL & Relational Databases
curriculum_tracks.tagline: Relational Algebra, Window Functions, Complex Joins & Subqueries

problems.title: Custom Promise.all Implementation
problems.subject: Frontend & Modern Web
problems.description: Implement a function customPromiseAll(promises) that behaves identically to the native Promise.all. Resolves when all input promises have resolved, preserving input order, and rejects immediately if any input promise rejects.
hints: Wrap each item in Promise.resolve(item) to handle both raw values and promises uniformly.
Maintain a counter of resolved promises. Do NOT check results.length since array index assignments can create sparse arrays.
Reject immediately upon catching any error.

problems.title: Deep Clone with Circular Reference Support
problems.subject: Frontend & Modern Web
problems.description: Implement a deep clone utility deepClone(value, seen = new WeakMap()) that creates an exact duplicate of nested JavaScript objects, arrays, and primitives while preserving circular references.
hints: Check if value is null or not an object to return primitives directly.
Use a WeakMap to track visited objects to prevent circular reference infinite loops.

problems.title: Flatten Deeply Nested Array
problems.subject: Frontend & Modern Web
problems.description: Write a function flattenArray(arr, depth = Infinity) that flattens a multi-dimensional array up to a specified depth.
hints: Iterate through the array and check if Array.isArray(item) and depth > 0.
Use recursion or a stack-based accumulator.

complexity.space: O(D) where D is max recursion depth

problems.title: Two Sum in Sorted Array
problems.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
problems.description: Given a 1-indexed array of integers numbers sorted in non-decreasing order, find two numbers that add up to target in O(1) additional space and O(N) time.
hints: Place one pointer at index 0 and one at the last index.
Advance left if sum < target; decrement right if sum > target.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses and Delimiters
problems.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
problems.description: Given a string s containing just '()[]{}', determine if the input string is valid with matching closing brackets in proper order.
hints: Push opening brackets onto a stack.
When encountering a closing bracket, compare with the top item popped from the stack.

problems.title: Coin Change Minimum Count
problems.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
problems.description: Given coins denominations and amount, return the fewest number of coins needed to make up that amount, or -1 if impossible.
hints: dp[i] is the minimum coins to make amount i.
dp[0] = 0, others Infinity.
dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i - coin] + 1) for each coin <= i.

problems.title: Group Anagrams by Character Count
problems.subject: Python & Algorithmic Scripting
problems.description: Given an array of strings strs, group anagrams together by signature key.
hints: Sort each string alphabetically to form a unique canonical signature key.
Group strings by this key in a Hash Map / Dictionary.

problems.title: Merge Overlapping Meeting Intervals
problems.subject: Python & Algorithmic Scripting
problems.description: Given intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i], merge all overlapping intervals into non-overlapping segments.
hints: Sort intervals by start time.
Compare current[0] with last[1]. If overlapping, last[1] = max(last[1], current[1]).

problems.title: LRU (Least Recently Used) Cache Design
problems.subject: System Design & Backend Architecture
problems.description: Design an LRUCache class with get(key) and put(key, value) operations executing in O(1) average time complexity.
hints: JavaScript Maps preserve insertion order.
Deleting and re-inserting moves a key to most recently used.

complexity.time: O(1) for both get and put

problems.title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
problems.subject: System Design & Backend Architecture
problems.description: Implement a TokenBucketRateLimiter class with allowRequest(tokensRequired, currentTimestampMs) using token refill rate per second.
hints: Replenish tokens based on elapsed seconds: Math.min(capacity, tokens + elapsedSec * refillRatePerSec).
Only deduct tokens if tokens >= tokensRequired.

problems.title: Second Highest Salary in Enterprise Staff
problems.subject: SQL & Relational Databases
problems.description: Given employees table with id and salary, return the second highest distinct salary or null if none exists.
hints: In SQL: SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employees WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM Employees).
In JavaScript: Deduplicate using Set, sort descending, check element at index 1.

problems.title: Department Top Earners via Join & Grouping
problems.subject: SQL & Relational Databases
problems.description: Given employees and departments, find the highest earner in each department and format as { department, employee, salary } sorted by department name ascending.
hints: Group employees by departmentId and record max earner per department.
Join against department lookup table to get department name.

agent_instruction_tuning_samples.system_prompt: You are an expert, encouraging coding mentor on CodeZenith. Give a focused Hint Level 1-3. Keep explanations under 120 words. Do not give away the complete solution immediately.
agent_instruction_tuning_samples.user_query: I am working on Custom Promise.all Implementation. Can you give me a hint? My code is failing when some promises resolve slower than others.
agent_instruction_tuning_samples.assistant_response: Think about array indexing versus completion counters! When an asynchronous promise resolves, place its result at its original index `results[index] = value;` rather than pushing to the end. Maintain a separate `completedCount` counter that increments whenever a promise fulfills. Only resolve the outer promise when `completedCount === promises.length`.
